subject: reasoning
question: Three of the following letter-clusters are alike in some manner and hence form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic :

 
• First and fourth letter → Difference between the position value according to the English alphabetic series is 6.
 
• Second and third letter → Difference between the position value according to the English alphabetic series is 5.

​​So,​

 
• Option - (1) : EQVK

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e3d5186116ecb76e2b7421174cca420e4020071c08627c2f96c521c07b57bf1.png] 

 
• Option - (2) : RDIX

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae7dcd138623e0eaf09197d1b003bfb84f5b4119569528c848d1979fbd2cef12.png] 

 
• Option - (3) : QFJV

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f76b0ee5652dc71805f121ef893c030aeda6c8a115fd3a365a0702a59f77904.png] 

 
• Option - (4) : IMRO

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/696aff7556c1a70648988f23ed44bf7b17373aa6815e591e480cc5c217c53bb1.png] 

Here, out of all options only **'****QFJV' doesn't follow the same logic as given**.

Hence, "**QFJV**" is the correct answer.
